title: seed_defaults must authorize Write up front (not lazily via register)
objective: Hardening from PHTASK-0029 /verify (runtime finding): PromptHub::seed_defaults -> defaults::seed_database authorized Write only LAZILY — the check lived in register(), which is reached only for not-yet-present templates. On an already-seeded store an anonymous/capability-less caller skipped every register and silently got Ok(0) instead of Unauthorized (list() has no RBAC). Fix (NO-DOWNGRADE, upgrade only): call RbacAuthManager::authorize_action(identity, Action::Write)? at the TOP of seed_database so the Write gate holds unconditionally, regardless of store state. Add a regression test that an anonymous caller is denied on an ALREADY-seeded store.
acceptance_criteria: seed_database authorizes Write before the existence probe
anonymous/capability-less caller is denied even when the store is already fully seeded
existing seeding behavior (idempotent insert for authorized callers) unchanged
source: discovered during /verify runtime observation of PHTASK-0029 (cycle 92)
policy_note: Owner directive 2026-06-13: NO DOWNGRADES. Strengthen the authorization boundary; never weaken a gate.
resolution: Added RbacAuthManager::authorize_action(identity, Action::Write)? as the first statement of defaults::seed_database (imports crate::auth::{Action, RbacAuthManager}); seeding now rejects unauthorized callers unconditionally, before the list() existence probe. Added regression test seed_database_requires_write_even_when_already_seeded (seed 6 as operator, then anonymous -> Unauthorized). Authorized idempotent behavior unchanged (6 then 0). Gates green: cargo test -p prompt-hub --all-features defaults; clippy --all-features --all-targets -D warnings; default build; fmt --check. Done via worktree loop/phtask-0044-seed-auth.
